methodology: The same frozen physical-host C -O2 and in-process ZX native executables ran both bundles. The same Wasm compiler and JS host ran both Wasm modules. Per-round and cohort medians use symmetric 1.5×IQR with inclusive interpolated quartiles, retaining raw values and excluded indices.
